newsitem.title: UK: ASDA considers buyback of 10.875 pct 2010 bonds.
newsitem.headline: ASDA considers buyback of 10.875 pct 2010 bonds.

text.p: ASDA Group Plc is considering a buyback of a maximum of 35 million stg nominal of its outstanding 10.875 percent bonds due 2010, arranger Merrill Lynch said on Thursday.
NatWest Markets will jointly arrange the buyback.
The price will be based on a spread of not less than 40 basis points over the 9.0 percent gilt due 2008.
Merrill Lynch said the nominal amount of bonds to be repurchased (if any) and the purchase spreads will be determined by ASDA at 1300 GMT for pricing at 1400 GMT.
ASDA is not obliged to buy back any bonds.
Earlier, ASDA launched a 200 million stg bond due 2007 via joint lead managers Merrill Lynch and NatWest Markets.
The bonds will be priced to yield 65 basis points over the 7.50 percent gilt due 2006.
ASDA is rated A2 by Moody's Investors Service.
